thread:
marta: Heads up — after merging the auth/retry parity patch into main, the ruby sampleapp is blowing up for me on CI with a Bundler mismatch error. Anyone seen this?

sam: saw a couple local failures, thought CI would be fine. what error?

marta: gist of the CI job: 
``` 
Fetching gems... ERROR: Your bundler version (2.4.12) is older than the one that created the lockfile (2.5.1).
Run `gem install bundler:2.5.1` and try again.
```

eden: hmm we've historically not pinned bundler for the sample apps, but the auth branch updated the lockfile from my machine which has 2.5.x. easy fix is to relax the check or update CI images.

dylan: PR 842 touches token refresh + small gem updates — I wonder if the merge included a new Gemfile.lock. Can you point to the commit?

marta: the merge was https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/commit/2f7c9b8 — includes oauth helper and bumped some dev deps. PR number is #842.

sam: quick options: (1) update the CI docker image to install bundler 2.5.1 before bundle install, (2) revert the lockfile changes in the sampleapp, or (3) regenerate lockfile in CI (less desirable). I can push a tiny CI patch.

eden: also, there was a small behavioral regression: after a 401 the new retry code retries but doesn't refresh the access token for a short-lived refresh token flow. I added a unit test but it failed in the sampleapp e2e. maybe that's what triggered manual testing and lockfile bump.

marta: yeah the e2e failure was noisy and someone updated the Gemfile.lock locally to get tests green which sneaked into the commit.

dylan: ok would prefer we keep sample apps stable — can you open a follow-up that: pins CI bundler to 2.5.1 and reverts the lockfile change in the sampleapp? then we can keep the auth patch separate.

sam: will do. pushing branch fix/ci-bundler-2-5-1 in a minute. cc @dylan for review.

ci-bot: Build started for commit 8c1f3a2 (fix/ci-bundler-2-5-1).

sam: uploaded tiny patch: 
``` 
- RUN gem install bundler:2.5.1
- bundle install --jobs 4
```

dylan: quick review: left two nits in the PR — one is a changelog entry request, other is please add a tiny integration case that simulates a 401+refresh to avoid regressions. both small. :eyes:

sam: added the changelog and test. PTAL.

ruby-sdk-bot: CI pipeline passed for PR #849 (fix/ci-bundler-2-5-1) — all checks green.

marta: thanks y'all — after that CI is clean and sampleapp deploys locally. one follow-up: let's add a brief note in devex onboarding about recommended bundler versions for sample apps to avoid this in future.

dylan: agreed. i'll add a short blurb to the devex README. :thumbsup:

marta: marking resolved for now. thanks for the fast turnaround!
